text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-lab-ops-07","cls":"internal_researcher"},"campaign_name":"OER_NiFeCo_screen_batch14","campaign_class":"routine_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate before deposition"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"thickness":200},"comment":"standard NiFeCo ternary, nominal thickness"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":850,"duration":7200,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"crystallization step per SOP-OER-3; FTO substrate"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"baseline CP at standard rate"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"duration":3600},"comment":"1 h stability check"},{"server":"model_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{},"comment":"append results to GP surrogate"}]}
